thread:
mira (Product): Heads up: launching the Remote Support JIT (RSJ) workflow for Redwood Private customers. This is an opt-in, auditable support path to assist on-prem / VPC installs without persistent Redwood access.

mira (Product): Why now: faster triage for pilot customers while keeping strong customer control over logs & keys. Pilot starts today (5 customers), broad opt-in rollout scheduled ~2 weeks.

jonah (EngInfra): Implementation notes: RSJ uses ephemeral credentials + a short-lived support container. Default mode is read-only; write capabilities require explicit escalation and dual-approval. Session metadata includes session-id, requestor, approver, duration, and session hash for integrity.

jonah (EngInfra): Quick CLI example: 
```
# enable RSJ for an org for 3h with approval required
redwood private rsj enable --org 012345 --duration 3h --approval required
```

jonah (EngInfra): New tooling: `redwood rsj diag` to gather agent traces and connectivity checks. On air-gapped installs ensure outbound to support.redwood.io on port 443 is allowed or use the support-proxy shim.

infra-bot: deploy: RSJ feature flag turned on in staging at 2026-03-23T18:42:00Z; will gate-rollout to production 2026-03-24 08:00 UTC.

sarah (Security): Security summary: Approved. Controls: MFA for approvers, org-admin consent mandatory, session recordings retained per customer policy (default 90 days; SOC2 customers set to 180), and KMS attestations required. No permanent credentials stored by Redwood.

sarah (Security): Note: customers can choose where recordings/telemetry land. If they opt-out of sending to Redwood, recordings remain in their sink; Redwood will validate hashes for audit purposes only.

mira (Product): Customer comms: one-pager FAQ and pilot onboarding checklist are in the Private docs space (internal link posted). Sales: please do not commit RSJ to any customer without the signed support addendum.

tony (Sales): Got it. Ill coordinate pilot invites and share the FAQ. Can Legal provide a short amendment text?

sarah (Security): Legal & Compliance: we'll draft an amendment. I'll share a template by EOD and attach to the pilot invites.

mira (Product): Ops: training sessions for Support/SRE/Sales on Wed 16:00 & Thu 00:00 UTC. Please attend if you're part of the pilot support rotation.

jonah (EngInfra): Oncall checklist: if session launch fails, check agent cert chain, org firewall rules, and that the customer's support-approval webhook is reachable. Use `redwood rsj debug --collect` and attach output to the ticket.

mira (Product): Action items: product ops to post FAQ link in customer channels; infra to run the staged rollout and monitor; security to run pilot audits; sales to brief pilot accounts.

mira (Product): TL;DR: RSJ = opt-in, JIT, auditable, read-first by default, integrates with customer KMS and log sinks. Pilots start now, org-wide opt-in in ~2w. Please review docs and join training. :white_check_mark:
